## Root #34147: a stale-base count, not a flake 2026-11-16T01:50Z

The `scripts/root-index.test.ts` red (`1663` vs `1664`) is #34147's own generated `content/docs/references/index.mdx`: that PR adds `DiffMetaItemRequestSchema` and committed the page count against base `b4eea88505`, and main has gained a reference page since. It reds deterministically until #34147 merges main and regenerates; it is not load or timing. Triage on the PR: comment 6905049333.

#34147 is out of the queue now and goes back only on a regenerated green head, so PRs queued behind it (the p0 fix #34205 among them) can be re-queued without waiting on it.
